## Premier League Clubs: Team Dashboards

Season trends, league context, passing, threat, pressing and goalkeeping for every club. Updated after each round of games.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis
clubs <- sort(list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE))
clubs <- clubs[!grepl("^[._]|^Images$|_files$", clubs)]
cards <- vapply(clubs, function(cl) {
  html <- list.files(cl, pattern = "_Dashboard\\.html$")
  if (!length(html)) return(NA_character_)
  thumb <- file.path(cl, sub("\\.html$", "_files", html[1]), "figure-html", "league ranks strip-1.png")
  if (!file.exists(thumb)) thumb <- "Images/Premier-League-ball.png"
  upd <- format(file.info(file.path(cl, html[1]))$mtime, "%d %b %Y")
  sprintf(paste0('<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-4"><div class="card season-card">',
                 '<div class="season-card-media"><img src="%s" class="card-img-top img-fluid" alt="%s"></div>',
                 '<div class="card-body"><h3><a href="%s">%s</a></h3><div class="text-muted">Updated %s</div></div></div></div>'),
          utils::URLencode(thumb), cl, utils::URLencode(file.path(cl, html[1])), cl, upd)
}, character(1))
knitr::asis_output(paste0('<div class="grid">', paste(na.omit(cards), collapse = "\n"), "</div>"))
```
